# Smashed Burgers & Co.

> Smash burger restaurant in Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala, India. Beef patties are smashed to order on a flat-top griddle. Fries are cooked in beef tallow. Open every day from 6 PM to 4 AM. Delivery through Zomato.

## Facts

- Name: Smashed Burgers & Co. (also written Smashed Burgers Co.)
- Address: Fes & Fred Eco Space, Thammanam-Pullepady Road, Kathrikadavu, Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala, India
- Phone: +91 79078 94764
- Hours: every day, 6 PM to 4 AM (next day)
- Delivery: Zomato, listed as "Smashed Burgers & Co, Kaloor"
- Live menu with current stock: https://menu.smashed.in/
- Instagram: @smashedburgersandco
- Tagline: "Obsession doesn't take days off"

## Menu

Prices in Indian rupees from the restaurant's live menu at https://menu.smashed.in/. Burgers are priced as doubles.
Stock changes through the night. Delivery prices on Zomato can differ. Bestsellers are marked ★.

### Starters
- Tallow Fries ★ (₹199): Fat-cut fries cooked in beef tallow, finished with salt and crushed pepper.
- Signature Beef Loaded Fries (₹279): Fries under cheese sauce and smashed beef.
- Cheese Loaded (₹239)

### Classic burgers
- OG Smash (₹299) [Single ₹199 / Double ₹299 / Triple ₹399]: Smashed beef, caramelised, with melted cheddar, house sauce and pickles in a toasted brioche bun.
- The Alchemy ★ (₹369) [Single ₹269 / Double ₹369 / Triple ₹469]: Smashed patties in signature sauce, melted cheese and caramelised onions. Sweet and tangy.
- Tokyo (₹419) [Single ₹319 / Double ₹419 / Triple ₹519]: Smashed patties, melted cheese and mushrooms sautéed in house Tokyo sauce.
- Jammin’ Bacon ★ (₹429) [Single ₹329 / Double ₹429 / Triple ₹529]: Smashed patties under smoky beef bacon jam, with cheese, pickles, lettuce and house sauces.
- Animal Smash (₹349) [Double ₹349 / Triple ₹449]: Two smashed patties, signature animal sauce, double melted cheese and crisp lettuce. A take on the California double animal style.
- Ranch Reserve ★ (₹529) [Double ₹529 / Triple ₹629]: Smashed patties with beef bacon bits, crunchy onion rings and signature ranch sauce.
- Double Smoke (₹449) [Double ₹449 / Triple ₹549]
- Double Bacon Cheese Burger (₹499) [Double ₹499 / Triple ₹599]

### Sandos
- Nashville Hot Chicken Sando (₹329): Fried chicken thigh in Nashville hot spice, crunchy pickles and house sauce on a toasted bun.
- Patty Melt (₹550)
